mapping_json.fidelity_notes: Fully physical+pierce kit — no element family per THE PHYSICAL RULE; identity entirely via geometry (line/fork) + ailment (bleed) + curse:sap. Call of the Hunt burst mapped via economy (cooldown reduction) not as separate skill — it is a passive-burst activator, not a geometry change.
